summary: Cemex filed a Form 6-K announcing the second installment of a previously approved ordinary cash dividend, following resolutions from its March 26, 2026 Ordinary General Shareholders Meeting. The USD 45.0 million installment pays holders of record as of September 15, 2026: MXN 0.017795 per Series A/B share, MXN 0.053385 per CPO and USD 0.031170 per ADS, using a 17.1277 MXN/USD Banco de Mexico rate. Payment dates are September 17, 2026 for shares and CPOs, and around September 24, 2026 for ADSs. This is a routine dividend notice, not a special situation.
